perm.content.forms.create_help: Create forms and change or delete the own ones.
perm.content.forms.admin_help: Change and delete all forms of the category.
perm.content.forms.submissions_help: See, export and delete the submissions of the forms of the category (the creator of a form always sees its submissions).
perm.content.forms.external_help: Send submissions to any e-mail address and to webhooks (without it only to members of the wiki).
forms.file_limits: Allowed: {types}; up to {n} files of at most {mb} MB each.
forms.thanks: Thank you, your submission has been received.
forms.mail_intro: A new submission of the form “{form}”:
forms.mail_confidential: A new submission of the confidential form “{form}”. Its content is only shown in the wiki:
forms.copy_intro: Thank you for your submission of the form “{form}”. Your details:
forms.state.not_open: This form is not open yet.
forms.state.sign_in: Please sign in to submit this form.
forms.state.full: This form takes no more submissions.
forms.state.already: You have already submitted this form.
forms.err.email: Please enter an e-mail address like name@example.org.
forms.err.url: Please enter an address starting with https://.
forms.err.tel: Please enter a phone number (digits, spaces, + ( ) - /).
forms.err.option: Please choose one of the options.
forms.err.file_type: {param}: this file type is not allowed.
forms.err.file_content: {param}: the content does not match the file type.
forms.err.macros: {param}: files with macros are not allowed.
forms.err.pdf_active: {param}: PDF files with scripts, actions or embedded files are not allowed.
forms.err.archive: {param}: the archive contains programs or is too large.
forms.err.virus: {param}: the virus scanner found a threat.
forms.err.scan_unavailable: {param}: the file could not be checked for viruses. Please try again later.
forms.ed.layout.free: Placed freely (in pixels; on small screens the grid is used)
forms.ed.layout_hint: Placed freely: screen readers and the keyboard follow the order of the field list, not the position. Check that both match.
forms.ed.copy: Signed-in persons get a copy by e-mail
forms.ed.store: Keep the submissions in the wiki
forms.ed.label: Label
forms.ed.prefill.user.name: Name of the signed-in person
forms.ed.position: Position x / y, size w / h (pixels)
forms.ed.allow_active: Allow PDF with scripts or embedded files
forms.ed.media_category: Also store in the media library (category ID, 0 = no)
forms.ed.virus_on: Every file is checked by the virus scanner.
forms.ed.virus_off: No virus scanner is set up (setting “clamd” of the plugin).
forms.type.heading: Heading
forms.error: The form could not be loaded or sent. Please try again.
forms.admin.title: Forms
forms.admin.intro: Uploads of forms are always checked by their content (file type, Office macros, active PDF content). A virus scanner checks every file in addition.
forms.admin.clamd_help: Address of clamd, e.g. tcp://clamav:3310 or unix:/run/clamav/clamd.ctl. Empty: no virus scan. If it is set but cannot be reached, uploads are refused.
forms.sig_typed: Or type your name as signature
forms.sig_canvas: Signature area: sign with the mouse, a pen or a finger – or type your name below.
forms.err.signature: Please sign or type your name.
forms.results.no_right: The results of this form are not public.
forms.ed.formula_help: Numbers, + − × ÷ ( ) and round(x, digits), min, max, abs, sum with the IDs of fields above: {ids}
forms.ed.pow: Proof of work against bots (the browser computes about a second; no CAPTCHA)
forms.ed.public_results: Everyone who sees the form may see the counts of the answers (macro “Form results”)
forms.ed.files: Store each submission as a file in the media library
forms.ed.files_name: File name (placeholders; empty: form and number)
forms.admin.icap_help: Address of an ICAP service, e.g. icap://scanner:1344/avscan. Can be used together with or instead of clamd.
limit.content.forms.submit_mb.help: Upper bound for one submission with all its files (also for guests). Each form allows at most the files its fields accept; this limit caps every form.
